scientific_integrity: All infinite-size claims follow from the complete seven-support by three-leaf-color case proof; finite replay is corroboration, not a substitute. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the three-color, threshold-one, synchronous open-neighbor cyclic rule on a complete clique with exactly one pendant leaf. It does not extend automatically to other color counts, multiple leaves, or distinct update models. Priority relative to unindexed publications remains uncertain.
title: Uniform three-layer cycle onset and nine-state basins on a pendant clique
